page.description: SparkyLinux editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A Debian-based distribution with a rolling testing base and a set of desktop editions from minimal to full, plus a semi-rolling variant on Debian stable.
pros: Debian base with Sparky's own tools and repository on top.
Several desktop editions (KDE, LXQt, Xfce, MATE and more) from one release.
A minimal CLI edition for building a system from scratch.
Regular point releases with a small download.
cons: The publisher links its ISOs through mirrors and archive.org, not one stable directory.
The publisher lists MD5 only, so the SHA-256 values here were computed by ROMinit.
Small community and support base compared with Debian itself.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so this page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for SparkyLinux; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write the ISO to a USB stick with dd or any image writer; writing erases the stick. The live session then installs to the chosen disk.
